summary: Assassin's Creed entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Assassin's Creed Mirage
entries.definitive_edition: Windows version with Valley of Memory free update installed

emulation.notes: Native Windows route; no emulator required.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC native resolution/settings with current patch

primary.version: Windows version with Valley of Memory free update installed
primary.why: Windows, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series, Luna, iPhone, and iPad are supported. PC storefronts and the Valley of Memory free update are available; for Sami's fidelity-first archive route, Windows has the strongest graphics/capture/settings ceiling while no platform-exclusive story content exists elsewhere.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows build from Ubisoft Connect, Steam, or Epic at the target capture resolution. Install the current patch and Valley of Memory update before recording, then use console/mobile only for comparison or ownership constraints.

entries.remaster_caveats: Not a remaster situation. The main caveat is update state: the archive route should include the free Valley of Memory story content and current gameplay updates.

entries.title: Assassin's Creed

emulation.notes: Use the current native or official release route where available.

primary.why: The PC Director's Cut is the highest-fidelity and most complete route: it carries the PC subtitle and exclusive investigation mission types, while Steam/GOG provide current PC distribution options.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Director's Cut Edition on Windows through GOG or Steam, apply compatibility fixes if needed, and capture at modern resolution. No console replay is needed unless comparing the original mission mix.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official modern remaster is sourced for the first game. The PC version may need compatibility/fix checks on modern Windows.

entries.title: Assassin's Creed II
entries.definitive_edition: Windows version with story DLC installed

emulation.notes: Native Windows route; modern compatibility fixes may be needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC at modern resolution with DLC installed

primary.version: Windows version with Battle of Forli and Bonfire of the Vanities installed
primary.why: Windows has the highest practical resolution/settings/capture ceiling for Assassin's Creed II. The game released across the original PS3/Xbox 360, Windows, OS X, Ezio Collection console, and Switch release families, plus the Battle of Forli and Bonfire of the Vanities DLC chapters. Use PC for the main run and verify the DLC/complete-content install before recording.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version through the current owned storefront, apply compatibility fixes if needed, and confirm the two DLC sequences are installed/unlocked. Use The Ezio Collection only for a console-remaster comparison capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: Battle of Forli and Bonfire of the Vanities were DLC chapters, so do not record a bare install as complete. The Ezio Collection is useful for comparison but is console/Switch-focused rather than a PC remaster.

entries.title: Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC version with DLC installed

emulation.notes: Native Windows route; modern compatibility/fix checks may be needed.

primary.version: PC version with single-player DLC installed
primary.why: The Windows release has the highest practical resolution/settings and capture ceiling. The later Switch Rebel Collection is a convenient bundled route, but it is not a fidelity upgrade over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows version through the current owned storefront, install the available story/single-player DLC before capture, and keep Switch Rebel Collection only for portable comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: No separate modern PC remaster is sourced here. Assassin's Creed Freedom Cry can be DLC or standalone; log it separately if archiving that campaign as its own title.

entries.title: Assassin's Creed: Brotherhood
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC version with single-player DLC installed

emulation.notes: Native Windows route; check compatibility with modern systems before playing.

primary.version: Windows version with single-player DLC installed
primary.why: The Windows release has the highest practical settings/capture ceiling for Brotherhood. The Ezio Collection is a useful console remaster route, but PC remains the fidelity-first archive path if the single-player DLC is installed.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows version through the current owned storefront, apply community fixes if needed, and verify the Da Vinci Disappearance and other single-player DLC availability before capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Ezio Collection is console/Switch-focused. Online multiplayer history is not a current primary-route requirement for Sami's story-first archive.

entries.title: Assassin's Creed: Revelations
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC version with single-player DLC installed

emulation.notes: Native Windows route; check compatibility with modern systems before playing.

primary.version: Windows version with single-player DLC installed
primary.why: The Windows release has the strongest settings and capture ceiling. The Ezio Collection is a useful console/Switch route, but not a PC remaster replacement.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows version through the current owned storefront, apply community fixes if needed, and verify single-player DLC availability before capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Ezio Collection is console/Switch-focused. Multiplayer/server history should not be treated as required current content for Sami's story-first route.

entries.title: Assassin's Creed III
entries.definitive_edition: Assassin's Creed III Remastered on Windows

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC Remastered at current settings

primary.why: Ubisoft's remaster includes the original solo DLC and Assassin's Creed Liberation Remastered, and PC gives the strongest capture/settings route.
primary.how_to_play: Use Assassin's Creed III Remastered on Windows with current patches. Treat Liberation Remastered as its own game entry if Sami wants that spin-off logged separately.

entries.remaster_caveats: Multiplayer from the original release is not the story-first archive target. Liberation Remastered is bundled but should still be tracked as a separate spin-off if added.

entries.title: Assassin's Creed Unity
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC version with Dead Kings installed

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC at current high settings

primary.version: Current PC version with Dead Kings installed
primary.why: Unity released on PC, PS4, and Xbox One, and the PC version has the highest capture/settings ceiling. Dead Kings is DLC, so the complete route should include it.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows build with Dead Kings installed and current patches. Record graphics settings and whether co-op/online features are part of the capture goal.

entries.remaster_caveats: No separate remaster route is sourced. Co-op/service behavior should be verified at capture time.

entries.title: Assassin's Creed Odyssey
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC version with Season Pass/story DLC installed

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC at current high settings

primary.version: Current PC version with story DLC/Season Pass content installed
primary.why: Odyssey's PC version has the highest settings and capture ceiling, and major DLC is available through the Season Pass and DLC store pages. A complete route should include Legacy of the First Blade and The Fate of Atlantis.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows build with the Season Pass/story DLC installed. Record protagonist choice, level scaling/difficulty, graphics settings, and which DLC/free Lost Tales content is included.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster route is sourced. Record DLC ownership, patch state, protagonist choice, and any Ubisoft Connect dependencies.

entries.title: Assassin's Creed Valhalla
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC Complete Edition or equivalent full DLC install

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC at current high settings

primary.version: Complete Edition / current PC version with Season Pass and Dawn of Ragnarok installed
primary.why: The PC version has the highest settings and capture ceiling, and Ubisoft's Complete Edition bundles the base game, Season Pass, Dawn of Ragnarok, and Berserker Pack. That makes complete PC the clearest fidelity and content route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows build with Complete Edition content installed. Record graphics settings, protagonist/gender-stream choice, difficulty/exploration settings, and which DLC/free content is included.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster route is sourced. Record DLC ownership, patch state, Ubisoft Connect dependency, and settings.

entries.title: Assassin's Creed Origins
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC Gold Edition or equivalent full story DLC install

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC at current high settings

primary.version: Gold Edition / current PC version with The Hidden Ones and The Curse of the Pharaohs installed
primary.why: Origins' PC version has the highest settings and capture ceiling, and the Gold/Season Pass route covers the major story expansions. Discovery Tour is useful context but is not a substitute for the main campaign.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows build with The Hidden Ones and The Curse of the Pharaohs installed. Record graphics settings, difficulty, level scaling, Discovery Tour use, and Ubisoft Connect dependency.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster route is sourced. Record DLC ownership, patch state, and Ubisoft Connect dependency.

entries.title: Assassin's Creed Rogue
entries.definitive_edition: Assassin's Creed Rogue Remastered on PS4 Pro/Xbox One X

emulation.notes: Use official console remaster for the main route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS4 Pro/Xbox One X remaster branch

primary.why: Ubisoft's Remastered release adds 4K support on PS4 Pro/Xbox One X, higher-resolution textures, and lighting/shadow upgrades. That makes the remaster the fidelity route, while the PC original remains useful for capture comparison.
primary.how_to_play: Play Rogue Remastered on PS4 Pro or Xbox One X where possible. Record patch, platform, DLC/bonus-content availability, and whether a PC original comparison was checked.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original PC branch and PC settings/capture route
secondary.what_to_play: Use only as a comparison if console remaster capture is not practical.
secondary.why: The remaster has documented visual upgrades, but the PC version remains a flexible original-branch route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record platform and bonus/DLC state; do not assume the original PC release and Remastered branch are identical.

entries.title: Assassin's Creed Syndicate
entries.definitive_edition: PC Gold Edition with Season Pass content

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC with all owned DLC

primary.version: Gold Edition / base game plus Season Pass content
primary.why: The PC Gold Edition route includes the base game and Season Pass content while allowing high-resolution capture and PC fixes/settings. Console versions are valid, but PC is the cleanest one-route fidelity/completeness archive target.
primary.how_to_play: Use the PC Gold Edition or base game with all owned DLC installed. Record storefront, build, DLC packs, graphics settings, Ubisoft Connect state, and whether the Jack the Ripper expansion is included in the run.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record exact DLC ownership, storefront, and Ubisoft Connect requirements.

entries.title: Assassin's Creed III: Liberation
entries.definitive_edition: Liberation Remastered via Assassin's Creed III Remastered on Windows

emulation.notes: Use native PC remastered route; Vita preservation only for original-hardware comparison.

primary.version: Assassin's Creed Liberation Remastered via Assassin's Creed III Remastered
primary.why: Liberation began as a PlayStation Vita spin-off and was later remastered and bundled with Assassin's Creed III Remastered. The PC remastered route is the best capture/settings path, while the Vita original matters for original hardware and touch/control context.
primary.how_to_play: Use Assassin's Creed III Remastered on Windows and play Liberation Remastered as its own logged entry. Record storefront/build, graphics settings, controller, whether Vita/HD versions were compared, and any bundled-content assumptions.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting the launch hardware route.
secondary.why: Remastered is cleaner for capture, but Vita is the original design context.

entries.remaster_caveats: Track this separately from Assassin's Creed III even though it is bundled with the remaster.

entries.title: Assassin's Creed: Altaïr's Chronicles

emulation.emulator: melonDS / DeSmuME only if original hardware is unavailable
emulation.notes: Prefer DS/3DS hardware; document emulator version and touch input method.

primary.why: Altaïr's Chronicles is a handheld/mobile spin-off and not the same game as Assassin's Creed or the later Assassin's Creed Chronicles series. The DS cartridge is the original route, while iOS/Android and other mobile versions have been delisted and should be logged only if already preserved.
primary.how_to_play: Use the original Nintendo DS cartridge on DS/3DS hardware, or a documented DS preservation setup. Record region, hardware/emulator, stylus/touch use, completion route, and whether delisted mobile versions were compared.

secondary.platform: iOS / Android / Java ME / webOS / Windows Phone
secondary.what_to_play: Use only if an already-owned/preserved copy is available.
secondary.why: The mobile versions were delisted and are not a clean current access path.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record region, touch/stylus behavior, and any mobile-port preservation caveats.

entries.title: Assassin's Creed: Bloodlines
entries.definitive_edition: Original PSP release through PPSSPP, with PS3 connectivity unlocks documented if available

emulation.notes: Use high internal resolution for capture; compare original PSP if controls or performance matter.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PSP hardware for authenticity; PPSSPP for high-resolution capture

primary.version: Original PSP release, upscaled through PPSSPP
primary.why: Bloodlines is a PSP-exclusive Assassin's Creed story entry. PPSSPP or original PSP hardware is the route; upscaled PPSSPP gives the best capture fidelity, while original hardware is the control/display reference. PS3 Assassin's Creed II connectivity unlocks should be documented separately if possible.
primary.how_to_play: Use the PSP UMD/PSN version on PPSSPP or original PSP. Record emulator version, internal resolution, texture filtering, control mapping, save state use, original hardware comparison, and whether PS3 Assassin's Creed II connectivity unlocks were tested.

secondary.why: PPSSPP is the better capture route, but PSP hardware is the baseline.

secondary.platform: PSP connected to PS3 Assassin's Creed II
secondary.exclusive_content: Cross-game unlocks between Bloodlines and Assassin's Creed II
secondary.what_to_play: Test only if the archive wants the connectivity content documented.
secondary.why: The connectivity is a unique platform feature but not required for the main story route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No known modern remaster. Record whether the route uses original hardware, PSN/UMD assets, or emulator enhancements.

entries.title: Assassin's Creed II: Discovery
entries.definitive_edition: Nintendo DS release, with iOS version documented only if an owned/archive copy exists

emulation.notes: Use original DS hardware if touch/screen behavior matters.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Nintendo DS hardware for authenticity, emulator for capture

primary.why: Discovery is a DS/iOS side-scrolling spin-off set during Assassin's Creed II. The iOS release has been removed from sale, so the DS version is the practical preserved route, with iOS kept as a historical comparison.
primary.how_to_play: Use original DS hardware or a DS emulator with owned media. Record region, emulator/hardware, screen layout, touch controls, completion route, story sequence context, and whether the delisted iOS version was compared from archival captures.

secondary.what_to_play: Document only from an already-owned install or archival capture.
secondary.why: The iOS version is no longer a reliable current access route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record that this is a spin-off set during Assassin's Creed II, not the main game.
